name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Replays jump taps you made just before landing or touching an orb, and delays ship/wave inputs a few ticks when they would crash. Set the strength in the mod settings.

ticks.name: Buffer ticks
ticks.description: How early a tap can be and still count. 1 tick = 1/240 s, so 4 ticks is about 1 frame at 60 FPS. 0 turns the buffer off. Used for the cube and for any mode whose own value below is -1.

ball-ticks.name: Ball ticks
ball-ticks.description: Buffer ticks for the ball. -1 uses the main value.

robot-ticks.name: Robot ticks
robot-ticks.description: Buffer ticks for the robot. -1 uses the main value.

spider-ticks.name: Spider ticks
spider-ticks.description: Buffer ticks for the spider. -1 uses the main value.

ufo-ticks.name: UFO ticks
ufo-ticks.description: Buffer ticks for the UFO (orbs only). -1 uses the main value.

buffer-rings.name: Buffer orbs
buffer-rings.description: Also replay taps made just before touching an orb or ring.

show-counter.name: Show replay counter
show-counter.description: Shows how many taps were replayed (this attempt and in total) at the bottom of the screen.

assist-enabled.name: Ship & wave assist
assist-enabled.description: Looks a few ticks ahead and, if a ship or wave press/release would crash, delivers it up to the limits below later instead. Skipped in dual mode and platformer, and whenever the look-ahead hits an orb, pad, trigger or portal.

ship-ticks.name: Ship delay limit
ship-ticks.description: Most ticks a ship input may be delayed. 1 tick = 1/240 s. 0 = off for ship.

wave-ticks.name: Wave delay limit
wave-ticks.description: Most ticks a wave input may be delayed. 1 tick = 1/240 s. 0 = off for wave.

assist-budget-ms.name: Look-ahead time budget (ms)
assist-budget-ms.description: If the look-ahead takes longer than this for one input, it is abandoned and your input passes through. Lower it if you notice lag.

assist-margin.name: Required safe ticks
assist-margin.description: After the tick where your raw input would crash, a delayed input must keep the hidden player alive this many ticks longer to count as a save. Higher = stricter, fewer but safer saves.
